connector.name: Sql Server Analyst MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only SQL Server Analyst MCP - safe schema, stored procedure, and performance analysis.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sql-server-analyst-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the coregentdevspace account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MSSQL_SERVER
env.description: SQL Server hostname or FQDN (e.g. <name>.database.windows.net for Azure SQL).

env.name: MSSQL_PORT
env.description: TCP port (default 1433; set 0 for named instance with dynamic port).

env.name: MSSQL_DATABASE
env.description: Default database to connect to. Most tools also accept an override argument.

env.name: MSSQL_PASSWORD
env.description: SQL authentication password. Quote values containing '#' in .env files.

env.name: MSSQL_ENCRYPT
env.description: Encrypt the connection (true|false). Required true for Azure SQL.

env.name: MSSQL_TRUST_SERVER_CERT
env.description: Trust self-signed certificates (true|false). Use true only for local dev.

env.name: ALLOWED_DATABASES
env.description: Comma-separated allowlist of databases the server may access. Empty = unrestricted.

env.name: ALLOWED_SCHEMAS
env.description: Comma-separated allowlist of schemas for schema tools. Empty = unrestricted.

env.name: MAX_ROWS
env.description: Default row limit per safe query (default 100).
